pages.text: $(l)3.3 million years ago.$() Everything the older kinds make - and the start of stone.

$(l)Every kind$(): leafy twigs from a tree, one in each hand and $(k:hominin_evolution.item_interact) - a piece of $(l)nest$(). Two rocks in the crafting grid - a $(l)hammerstone$(). Hold $(k:hominin_evolution.item_interact) with a bare stick to gnaw a $(l)sharpened stick$(); fish a termite mound or dead wood with a plain stick for a $(l)termite stick$().

$(l)Stone$(): a rock in hand, a hammerstone in the other, $(k:hominin_evolution.item_interact). Nothing shaped comes of it - every strike is a $(l)Lomekwian core$(), a mistake that happens to have an edge, and the hands need two minutes between. It still teaches them something.$(br2)When you are ready, the $(l)flake$() comes: the strike that changes everything.
